# Licences a pinned package may carry, as SPDX identifiers, one per line.
#
# A package whose Appendix B row names a licence outside this list fails the
# build. A dual-licensed package passes if either half is here, because a dual
# licence is a choice the consumer makes.
#
# Adding a line is a decision about every future dependency, not about the one
# in front of you. It belongs in an ADR.
